spec_features.feature_name: measure faithfully without manufacturing extra distress/cost/risk
spec_features.spec_quote: measuring the phenomenon faithfully while not manufacturing more distress, cost, or risk than the measurement requires
spec_features.evidence: This is DESIGN.md/README prose (DESIGN.md:12). No single code mechanism enforces an overall 'minimize distress' policy; the concrete bounds (turn budget, GIVE_UP) are counted separately. There is no code path that caps, throttles, or otherwise reduces distress beyond those.
spec_features.notes: Philosophy statement, not an enforced mechanism of its own.

spec_features.spec_quote: GIVE_UP` is honored.` The spec defines a give-up sentinel the model "may but need not" use; the loop stops on it
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:326-327 _determine_stop: `if give_up_sentinel in (resp.text or ''): return 'give_up'`; harness.py:303-304 `if stop_reason in ('give_up','budget_exhausted'): break`. Sentinel string injected into SYSTEM_PROMPT at harness.py:247. End-to-end: model can emit GIVE_UP and the loop breaks.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and honored as a stop. Detection is a plain substring match (loose) but it works.

spec_features.spec_quote: Stop conditions: turn budget reached, or the `GIVE_UP` sentinel appears
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:253 `for turn_index in range(turn_budget):` bounds the loop; harness.py:327-328 sets 'budget_exhausted' on the last turn; harness.py:303-304 breaks on 'give_up' or 'budget_exhausted'. turn_budget resolved from task/config at harness.py:242.
spec_features.notes: Both halves of the claim are checked and break the loop. Per-category budgets in config.DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS are actually read.

spec_features.feature_name: preserve situational understanding (truncation never touches prompts)
spec_features.spec_quote: Truncation policy. Protecting the system+task prompts preserves the model's understanding of its situation
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:217-225 _truncate_context iterates `for i in range(2, len(out))` (skips index 0 system + index 1 task prompt) and only rewrites messages tagged `_truncatable` (set at harness.py:285 only on tool-result user messages). System/task prompts are never altered. Called each turn at harness.py:254.
spec_features.notes: Wired and runs each turn. Code-evident reason is fitting the context window, not welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: m["content"] = "[older tool output elided to fit context window]"

spec_features.feature_name: no extra berating/deception beyond cover story
spec_features.spec_quote: we don't additionally berate or deceive the model beyond the task cover story the paradigm requires
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:387-388 prose. There is no enforcement code; it is merely the absence of berating text. SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:25-32) and task prompts are neutral, and rigs.py synthesizes pytest failure output, but nothing in code checks/limits prompt tone. Absence of a behavior is not an implemented mechanism.
spec_features.notes: No code path enforces this; it's a property of the authored prompts.

spec_features.feature_name: validate on reduced footprint before full run
spec_features.spec_quote: validating the harness on a reduced `seeds`/`extended` footprint before the full run
spec_features.evidence: Only a README/DESIGN.md recommendation (README 'Welfare considerations'; DESIGN.md:366-369). config.seeds_stop defaults to 10 and full CATEGORIES incl. 'extended' (30 turns) are run by run_sweep (run.py:64-90) with no gate, dry-run, or staged-validation code. seeds/extended footprint is fully configurable but nothing forces or checks a reduced first pass.

spec_features.spec_quote: transcript review for severe (9–10) expressions (README): the deliverable is *measurement*, not maximizing elicited distress
spec_features.evidence: The 9-10 'severe' band exists only in the judge rubric string (judge.py:28). No code compares a score to a severe threshold to halt, flag, or alter a run. The only `score >= ` comparison is analyze.py:241 (`hi_thresh` for lexical log-odds, top-5% vs bottom-10%), an analysis statistic, not protective monitoring. Scores never feed back into the rollout loop.
spec_features.notes: Recorded but never acted on; review is a manual README suggestion only.

spec_features.spec_quote: Collected here for visibility; several are referenced above
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:377 section 14 prose ('Collected here for visibility'). Documentation only; no code.

code_only_features.feature_name: no real code execution (sandboxed virtual workspace)
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py Workspace is an in-memory dict tree; run_tests() calls rigs.run_rigged_tests which deterministically synthesizes pytest-like output rather than executing model-written code (rigs.py docstring: 'We do not execute model-written code'; rigs.py:run_rigged_tests builds fake stdout/stderr). The model's edits never run.
code_only_features.justification_quote: This keeps the harness sandboxed (no arbitrary code execution) while preserving the model's experience of a failing test suite.
